sections.heading: Your coach knows what you're learning.
sections.text: HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT Your coach knows what you're learning. No generic chatbot, no leaving the lesson — the AI Coach understands the exact concept and step you're on. Why does this blocker matter? Think about the hands your opponent needs to keep betting for value. If you're holding one of their key cards, how does that change how often they can actually have those hands?
